name: airsupply-web
description: The airsupply page. Elm owns the state and the view; js/api.js owns the add-on's HTTP API.

scripts.build: elm make src/Main.elm --optimize --output=dist/assets/elm.js && esbuild js/app.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --outfile=dist/assets/app.js && cp index.html dist/
scripts.dev: elm make src/Main.elm --output=dist/assets/elm.js && esbuild js/app.js --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/assets/app.js && cp index.html dist/
